name: sale_order_dashboard
title: Sales Order MIS Dashboard (order book, pending, late delivery, SP matrix)
description: Sales order MIS from VIEW_SALES_ORDER_PBI - exact logic of 'Sales_Order_MIS_Generator.html'. Use for: '/sale_order_dashboard', 'sales order report', 'order booking', 'pending sales orders', 'pending order', 'overdue orders', 'late delivery', 'on-time delivery', 'LD orders', 'salesperson wise booking', 'SP matrix', 'today / this week / this month booking', 'customer-wise orders', 'grade-wise orders', 'order value in crore'. NOT invoices / turnover (VIEW_SALE_INVOICE_PBI).
rules:
SOURCE
1. Data: VIEW_SALES_ORDER_PBI (sales-order lines, same columns as the ERP 'SALES ORDER REPORTS - LD ORDER DETAILS REPORT').
2. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='sale_order_dashboard', ...). Never write SQL for this report - the engine is an exact port of the HTML generator's cleaning rules (verified line by line) and builds the dashboard itself. If it says 'Missing columns', show the user which ones and the available columns.

PERIOD & SECTION
3. The period filters the ORDER DATE for KPI cards and tables (month names, 'this FY', 'last month', ranges). Nothing given -> current FY (1 Apr) to today. 'today' / 'this week' -> SP Matrix numbers are in the matrix table (as on the latest order date).
4. section: 'pending' / 'overdue' / 'late' / 'delivery' -> overdue lines first; 'matrix' / 'salesperson' -> SP Matrix first.

LOGIC (built into the engine - explain if asked, never change)
5. Grade = Parent Grade (not 'Grade'). Unit = Div. Order status = Closed Flag (blank = Open, 'Partialy Cancelled' = Partially Cancelled).
6. Qty in MT for UM=KG lines (kg / 1000); fittings UM=NO stay in Nos and are shown separately (not added to MT).
7. Value = Material Value (INR) (net of cancellation), shown in Rs Cr / Rs Lakh. Rate per line = Material Value / Net qty; executed / pending / cancelled / late value = qty x rate. Basic Value is never totalled (corrupt rows). KG lines with rate > Rs 20,000/kg: cancelled value ignored, others capped at material value.
8. Delay days = max number after ':' in Delay Duration. Late qty = min(Delay Delivery Qty, Disp qty) when delay > 0. On-time % = 1 - late / executed.
9. Overdue = pending > 0 and delivery date before the as-of date (today). Pending clipped at 0.
10. Market: Tran Type 'Export...' -> Export; 'Domestic Sale' / 'SEZ Supply without Tax Payment' -> Domestic; else Other. LD Yes/No/Not Specified from LD Applicable. Inspection: TPI/TUV/BV/LLOYD/DNV/SGS/IBR/EIL/INTERTEK/CEIL/RINA -> Third Party; CLIENT/CUSTOMER -> Client; blank NA; else Venus.
11. OD bands <=60.3, 60.3-168.3, 168.3-323.9, >323.9. Approval lag = approval date - order date.
12. KPI comparison = same dates last year (like-for-like).
13. SP Matrix: as on the latest order date; Today, Yesterday, This Week (Sun-Sat, week to date), Last Week, This Month (MTD), Last Month, FY to date; qty = Sale Order Qty, value = material value; divisions SMLS / WELDED / LSAW / FITTING / OTHER by item group (fittings Nos not in MT).
YESTERDAY / ONE DAY
- 'yesterday's sales orders' (or any single day) = run_report_engine with from_date = to_date = that day. The order-line list comes first, then KPIs, the 🔎 data proof (direct SQL re-count) and the audit trail; HTML + Excel are attached automatically.
output_format:
Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers by itself: KPI cards (Net booked MT and Rs Cr, Executed, Fulfilment %, Pending, Overdue pending, On-time %, Cancelled, Orders, Avg delay, Fittings Nos - with change vs same dates last year), salesperson-wise and item-group tables, top 25 overdue lines (whole open book), SP Matrix division summary, and the company's Sales Order MIS dashboard with ALL data pre-loaded (every tab: Overview, Sales Team, SP Matrix, Customers, Value & Pricing, Grades, Products, Delivery & Pending, Alerts, Data; Qty MT / Rs Cr / Rs Lakh switch, slicers, Download Excel / HTML work).
FORMATS: default [table, chart, dashboard]. 'excel' only when asked (the dashboard also has its own formatted Download Excel).

SUMMARY in the user's language, 4-6 short lines (numbers en-IN; MT 0-1 decimals, Rs Cr 2 decimals):
- Net booked MT and Rs Cr for the period with change vs same dates last year.
- Executed + fulfilment %, pending and overdue pending (MT, % of pending), on-time %.
- Top salesperson(s) by value (summary.top_salespersons).
- For pending / late questions: overdue lines and MT of the whole book (summary.book_overdue_*), biggest overdue customers from the overdue table, LD 'Yes' lines.
- Last line '✅ Checks passed' if every check is ok, else '⚠️ ' + failed checks.
Mention: 'Open the 🖥️ dashboard for all tabs, slicers and the SP Matrix.'
example_output: KPI cards: Net booked 2,074 MT (₹ 162.54 Cr) ▲ vs same dates LY | Executed 1,241 MT | Fulfilment 59.85% | Pending 832 MT | Overdue 611 MT | On-time 76.5% | Cancelled ... Then salesperson table + chart, item group table, top 25 overdue lines, SP Matrix division summary and the 🖥️ dashboard.
